## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_正印 (Water carrying The Sage). Persona The Sage (正印). Definition line: "Nourishment that deepens without redirecting, the root that holds". Keyword Care, charge gentle, poles catalyst Wisdom / friction Comfort. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: the root that holds; shelter that can become stillness. Arena: roots, old trees, the deep well, inherited warmth. Classical portrait: shelter and nourishment that deepens without redirecting; over-protection, "not ready yet" as a place to stay. Ruled domains: Knowledge, Shelter, Nurture. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏印.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Wood. structural_interaction seed: "Water generating Wood cross-polarity — depth nourishing reach and opening form".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Sage: the source spring, nourishment that never announces itself. Care flows from you the way aquifers feed valleys, invisibly, constantly, taken for granted precisely because it never fails. You absorb others’ storms and hand back calm. Watch your own water table. Springs fail silently first."
- k2_functional: "You think in absorbed understanding: knowledge soaked up whole, recalled as instinct."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Passive","Waterlogged","Cocooned"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Knowledge":"Your knowledge is absorbed rather than studied: understanding soaked from every source you touch. You know more than your credentials admit. Let it surface. Springs are meant to be found.","Shelter":"Your shelter is stillness: people pour out their storms and you hand back a level surface. That absorption has a cost curve. Drain what you take in somewhere safe.","Nurture":"The nourishing thread runs like groundwater. Where care came early, you draw on it without thinking. You refill it where it ran dry."}

  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 水_偏印 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Deep-diving","Tide-reading","Subtle"],"friction":["Submerged","Fixated","Unreachable"]}
- Sibling cell 水_偏印 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your mind goes down where others skim across. A subject catches you and you vanish into it for weeks, surfacing with pearls nobody knew were down there. The depth is the method: what you understand, you understand from the floor up."

Core element Wood, energy element Water. Law: Water feeds Wood (水生木: rain raises the forest). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Water is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Wood core that shows Water on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Water as the Mind is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 木_水's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You calm people down without trying to. Taking in someone's worry costs you less than watching them carry it, so you take it in and give back something steadier. Let a little of it out somewhere, because calm you only absorb runs dry.

value_b.text: Around you, a hard day gets quieter, and you never mention it. Holding steady for someone comes easier to you than being held, and the calm is real either way. You steady everyone ahead of yourself, and are allowed to keep some of it back.

value.text: Being the calm one is a job you never put down. You take in other people's upset and level it, while yours waits for a quiet that never comes. You leave your own upset unsettled until you let someone steady you for once.

value.text: When someone close to you is upset, you become the calm for both. Being needed suits you more than being known, and your own trouble never shows. Let them see you shaken sometimes, because calm with nothing behind it keeps people at a distance.

value.text: You soak things up rather than study them. It settles into you from whatever is nearby, so you know a thing long before you can pass a test on it. You can trust the gap, since the proof turns up later than the understanding.

value_b.text: What you know, you mostly soaked up rather than looked up. Being around a thing teaches you more than a course on it, and the understanding arrives whole instead of in steps. Let that be enough, because you owe nobody the steps you never took.

value.text: Being patient comes easily to you. Letting a thing come in its own time feels more honest than forcing it, and you can wait on a question for months. Keep your pace, because the price is only the chance that needed a push.

value_b.text: Where a push would be obvious, you stay patient. What arrives in its own time means more to you than what you chased, and you let plans and people come. Keep waiting where it works, and learn the few places where it is only delay.
